description: IS 694 specifies IS 5831 for its PVC insulation and sheath material requirements.
IS 1554 (Part 1) specifies IS 5831 for its heavy-duty PVC insulation material.
IS 16102 requires both Part 1 (Safety) and Part 2 (Performance) for complete LED lamp compliance.
IS 16103 requires both Part 1 (Safety) and Part 2 (Performance) for complete LED module compliance.
IS 16102 (Part 1) requires checking IS 16108 for photobiological and optical radiation safety.
IS 16102 (Part 2) uses IS 16105 for testing the lumen maintenance of the LED lamps.
IS 16102 (Part 2) uses IS 16106 for electrical and photometric measurements.
IS 456 structural design specifies IS 1786 for the high strength deformed steel reinforcement bars.
IS 456 specifies IS 383 for the coarse and fine aggregates used in the concrete mix.
IS 456 utilizes IS 10262 for the proper proportioning and formulation of the concrete mix.
IS 456 utilizes IS 516 for laboratory testing of the compressive and flexural strength of concrete.
SP 34 acts as the official practical detailing and bar bending handbook for concrete designed under IS 456.
IS 456 relies on IS 875 to calculate dead live wind and snow loads for structural design.
IS 456 relies on IS 13920 for ductile detailing of structures in earthquake-prone zones.
IS 456 specifies IS 9103 when chemical admixtures are added to the concrete mix.
IS 16102 (Part 1) applications are guided by SP 72 (National Lighting Code) for visual environment design.
